# Lensfun calibration test data

`lensfun-canon.xml` is a subset of the Lensfun database at tag **v0.3.4**:
https://github.com/lensfun/lensfun/blob/v0.3.4/data/db/slr-canon.xml

Copyright Lensfun database contributors; individual calibration credit comments
are preserved in the XML. The Canon EOS 5D Mark II and Canon EF 40mm f/2.8 STM
entries are unchanged; unrelated entries were removed. This adapted subset is
licensed under **Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported**:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
Legal text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/legalcode

The upstream license declaration is in:
https://github.com/lensfun/lensfun/blob/v0.3.4/README.md#license

These calibration values are regression data, not a production database or an
endorsement by Lensfun. Schist's independent implementation of the published
mathematical models is not a binding to Lensfun. Runtime users supply their own
Lensfun XML files. The main project license does not replace this data license.
